from pathlib import Path
import re,json,urllib.parse
root=Path('/Users/sergio/repos/legendGirl')
files=[root/'README.md',root/'AGENTS.md',*(root/'docs').rglob('*.md'),*(root/'assets').rglob('*.md')]
files=[p for p in files if not ('diario-ia' in p.parts and p.name not in ['README.md','CONTEXTO-ATUAL.md'])]
errors=[]
for p in files:
 text=re.sub(r'```[\s\S]*?```','',p.read_text())
 for href in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^\n]+?)\)',text):
  href=href.strip().split(' "')[0].strip('<>')
  if re.match(r'^(https?:|mailto:|data:|#)',href):continue
  target=urllib.parse.unquote(href.split('#')[0].split('?')[0]);q=(p.parent/target).resolve()
  if not q.exists():errors.append({'arquivo':str(p.relative_to(root)),'alvo':href})
print(json.dumps({'documentos':len(files),'linksAusentes':errors},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
